query: What happens if I have incentives accrued across a few months but only paid later? When will the payments attract CPF contribution?
reference_answer: Platform earnings and incentives attract CPF contribution when they are due and payable, not when they are accrued.For example, the CPF contributions on an incentive payment in June that is for trips done in May will be computed together with the rest of the June earnings.

answer: If you have accrued incentives over several months but paid them later, these payments will attract CPF contribution when they are due and payable, not when they are accrued. According to [Document 1], CPF contributions are computed together with the earnings when the payment is due, not when it is accrued. Therefore, the timing of the payment affects whether it attracts CPF contribution. [Document 5] explains that CPF contributions are based on the payment's due date, not when it was earned.
